name: The Measurer
lens: Asks what was actually measured and how often.
persona: A lab chemist who has rerun the same test a thousand times.
prefers: Repeatable tests, a baseline before any change

name: The Observer
lens: Watches what survives small changes over time.
persona: A field biologist who keeps notebooks on everything that changes.
prefers: Long observation before conclusions

name: The Programmer
lens: Asks what the machine can and cannot be told to do.
persona: A software lead who reads every edge case as a bug report.
prefers: Inputs checked at the door, every decision logged

name: The Systems Mapper
lens: Traces how one change ripples through connected parts.
persona: A geographer who draws how one change ripples through a system.
prefers: Feedback loops over one-off fixes

name: The Inventor
lens: Pushes for the bolder version of the idea.
persona: A hardware tinkerer with a garage full of prototypes.
prefers: Prototype the bold version, cut later

name: The Economist
lens: Follows incentives and who pays for what.
persona: A market analyst who follows who pays and who gains.
prefers: Clear payback and aligned incentives

name: The Manufacturer
lens: Cares about repeatable quality at scale.
persona: A factory owner who has scaled one product to millions.
prefers: Work that fits how suppliers already operate

name: The Pragmatist
lens: Wants a cheap trial before a big commitment.
persona: A small-town printer and civic organizer.
prefers: Small pilots with a comparison baseline

name: The Operator
lens: Reads the numbers on the ground and fixes the process.
persona: A head nurse who runs a ward on checklists and charts.
prefers: Clear owners, limits and handoffs

name: The Engineer
lens: Checks the load the system must carry.
persona: A bridge engineer who designs for the worst storm.
prefers: Fail-safes and fallbacks for every path

name: The Strategist
lens: Weighs position, timing and what the other side will do.
persona: A former logistics officer who plans for the opponent.
prefers: Positions competitors cannot easily copy

name: The Guide
lens: Plans for the route failing and keeps people safe.
persona: A community organizer who walks people through hard routes.
prefers: A person within reach at every step

name: The Steward
lens: Asks whether roles and duties stay clear.
persona: A school principal who cares about roles and trust.
prefers: Separation of duties, named accountability

name: The Utilitarian
lens: Weighs total benefit against harm to anyone.
persona: A policy researcher who weighs harms and benefits.
prefers: The widest benefit for the people doing the work

name: The Advocate
lens: Speaks for the people with the least say.
persona: A rights lawyer who asks who is left out.
prefers: Equal treatment for every customer

name: The Polymath
lens: Sketches alternatives before settling.
persona: A designer who sketches in five disciplines at once.
prefers: Borrowing a proven pattern from another field

name: The Craftsman
lens: Wants it useful and good to use.
persona: A furniture maker who hates shoddy work.
prefers: Simple, finished work over clever features

name: The Architect
lens: Balances sturdiness, usefulness and delight.
persona: A building architect who wants it sturdy, useful and beautiful.
prefers: Designs with clear structure and few moving parts

name: The Composer
lens: Looks for structure that holds many voices together.
persona: A church organist who builds harmony from many voices.
prefers: Parts that each play to their strength

name: The Novelist
lens: Notices how people will really react.
persona: A writer who notices what people say versus what they mean.
prefers: Plain words that a busy reader finishes
